title: SkillMemberWarning

kind.description: What the warning is: name-unlike-folder (its name is not its folder's name), frontmatter-name-invalid (its frontmatter name fails the skill-name rule, so it is named after its folder) or sidecar-invalid (its readiness sidecar does not read, and counts as none).

description: A warning on a member, which stays in the skill set.
